title: PartToolGen Task Effect Report
description: Task-effect report schema. Legacy selected_function_* fields are retained for older symbolic planner reports; current image-grounded benchmark reports should prefer selected_contact_point_ref and selected_motion_axis_ref when reporting tool-side refs. Surface-normal facts belong in scene or environment metadata, not as current public tool refs.

selected_function_contact_ref.description: Legacy V0 field; prefer selected_contact_point_ref for current image-grounded benchmark reports.

selected_function_axis_ref.description: Legacy V0 field; prefer selected_motion_axis_ref for current image-grounded benchmark reports.
